sites.name: Dru Barner Campground
sites.about: Dru Barner Campground offers 48 campsites that are nestled in the forest just 6 miles from Georgetown, CA. The campground offers access to trails, creeks and is a short drive from some nearby reservoirs. This campground was designed for equestrians, but it can also be used by tent, camper, trailer…
sites.directions: 7.5 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs Road (Forest Road 1), then 1 mile north east on Forest Road 13N16 and 0.5 miles northwest on Forest Road 13N58.
sites.restrictions: Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. Please use the metal fire rings provided. A campfire permit is required for fires at units without established fire rings. Make sure your fire is dead out before leaving. Check out time is 1:00 p.m. Check ahead. Campfires may not be allowed during…
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 6 months in advance of your first night’s stay. WEBSITE: Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

sites.name: Ponderosa Cove Group Campground
sites.feeText: $175/ group of 75 people. There are also fees for extra vehicle, pets, and wood is available for purchase from host. 5 vehicle spurs and a parking area for 10 vehicles.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Ponderosa Cove greets group campers with shaded campsites close to scenic Stumpy Meadows Reservoir. The campground provides a pleasant destination for bird watching and nature viewing, in addition to activities at the lake.
sites.directions: 17 miles east of Georgetown on Wentworth Springs road. East of the dam on the north side of the road.
sites.restrictions: Please check with the campground attendant or entrance board before setting up your camp. Please keep family pets on a leash at all times. Use only dead and down wood for your campfires. Make sure your fire is dead out before leaving. Check ahead. Campfires may not be allowed during. Check out…
sites.reservations: CALL 1-877-444-6777, four days to 360 days in advance of your first night’s stay. Recreation.gov. Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover accepted.

sites.name: Stumpy Meadows Campground
sites.feeText: $28/ single site. $56/ double site. $28/overnight camp on the boatramp. $10/day use. Other fees: Dumping waste tank and extra vehicle fees = $10.00.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Stumpy Meadows, on the Stumpy Meadows Reservoir, provides an enjoyable setting in a heavy conifer forest with easy access to an array of water activities.
